title: ValidatorFixture
description: schemaVersion 2.0.0. Test/fixture-only shape bundling a validator reference, a sequence of semantic actions and the expected evidence/outcome for cross-runtime parity testing (07_08 §25 checklist; §3 RUNTIME_FIXTURE_BUNDLE). New in WEB-M2 — 07_08 lists the required contents narratively but reserves no schema filename for this shape; designed for this implementation. Never served as production content.

parityGroup.description: Fixtures sharing the same parityGroup must produce the same expectedOutcome across runtimes (07_08 §11 cross-runtime equivalence).
